tune.name: Habanera: L'amour est un oiseau rebelle

motifs.name: Habanera answer: que nul ne peut apprivoiser

colours.name: sand
colours.source: sun on the square, the arena

acts.name: SEVILLE
acts.happens: Carmen crosses the crowded square to its centre.
acts.set: Half the grid is dim sand people, standing still and murmuring.
acts.characters: Carmen alone, red, starting at the crowd's edge.
acts.actions: She walks a cell per beat; the people beside her brighten and swell as she passes. Wide, mid as she starts, close following her, wide as she stops.
acts.music: Habanera bass; a murmur of tiny notes from random people; a soprano note per step.
acts.emotion: Only she moves, so she's all the eye can follow; the crowd turning to look says she's magnetic.

acts.name: L'AMOUR
acts.happens: She sings the Habanera to everyone.
acts.set: The square sways on the bass, every other cell.
acts.actions: Each semitone of the slide lights a ring of red further out from her.
acts.music: The Habanera, twice, soprano, with the answer phrase.
acts.emotion: The tune is the picture: her voice literally spreads over the crowd.

acts.name: THE FLOWER
acts.happens: She throws her flower to José.
acts.characters: José appears alone in blue, named.
acts.actions: A red spark arcs from her to him and stays beside him as one red dot; his heart beats.
acts.music: A rising arpeggio for the throw; heartbeat drum; a held tenor note.
acts.emotion: An object that stays says the choice lasts.
acts.wink: Somebody in the dark crowd says BOF. as José first lights up, with a two-note shrug.

acts.name: TORÉADOR
acts.happens: Escamillo arrives and the crowd switches to him.
acts.feeling: A star arrives and José is eclipsed.
acts.set: Two fixed blocks of crowd, one each side, from Iain's sketch.
acts.characters: José, Carmen and Escamillo in a line.
acts.actions: José's side cheers (flashing), Escamillo's boos. Drum roll; mid as Escamillo walks in through his crowd; close as he lands with a fanfare; wide as his side goes wild and José's falls quiet.
acts.music: Snare roll, a fanfare up the chord, then the Toréador tune over a march bass.
acts.emotion: The crowd's cheering is the scoreboard; the entrance gives him grandeur.

versions.label: he crosses, she follows
versions.idea: He walks to the centre, the crowd glows for him, she hops beside him.

versions.label: two magnets
versions.idea: The crowd tips towards him ring by ring until she goes too.

versions.label: the crowd as two blocks
versions.idea: Iain's sketch: rivals in a line, crowds either side flashing as they cheer.

acts.name: JEALOUSY
acts.set: The world goes dark; only him.
acts.characters: José, then Carmen boxed in, the gold outside.
acts.actions: Close on José: his heart stumbles, his blue turns green, then her flower. Mid: green creeps out from him a group per note. Wide: she's boxed in.
acts.music: Heartbeat; her Habanera sung upside down by him; the room closes in.
acts.emotion: Starting close on him says whose feeling it is; the green leaving him says where it comes from.

versions.label: the flower turns blue
versions.idea: His blue ink boxes her in.

versions.label: green-eyed monster
versions.idea: A new green light for jealousy only.

versions.label: green ink from José
versions.idea: His blue turns green, then the green boxes her in.

acts.name: THE KNIFE
acts.happens: She refuses him and he kills her.
acts.characters: José steps up to her; they end side by side.
acts.actions: Mid on the walk; close and silent; UN COUTEAU !; she flashes white and red; still close as she fades; wide as a red curtain falls and leaves him alone, blue again.
acts.music: Cheering, three beats of silence, snares on the flashes, her answer phrase slowed, the slide falling with the curtain.
acts.emotion: Silence before the hit, then time on her fading, so the pity lands on her.
acts.wink: José's MERDE ! and a falling uh-oh, a beat after the stab, before her last phrase.

versions.label: the last walk
versions.idea: He walks to her while the crowd cheers offstage; silence; the hit.

versions.label: the rings
versions.idea: Collapsing red rings from his position.

versions.label: a white blade
versions.idea: A white dot between them; rejected as big and odd, replaced by her flashing.

acts.name: LIBRE
acts.happens: She's free; the curtain comes down.
acts.actions: One red dot rises from where she fell and off the top; petals drift down slowly; two last chords light the whole grid red; blackout; silence.
acts.music: The fate motif, slow and low over a held D; a long dark room; fortissimo final chords that ring out.
acts.emotion: The ending gets the most time: room to wallow before the loop.
